text: If you have the words, there's always a chance that you'll find the way.
author: Seamus Heaney
source: Stepping Stones: Interviews with Seamus Heaney

text: It took me quite a long time to develop a voice, and now that I have it, I am not going to be silent.
author: Madeleine K. Albright

text: My advice for life: dance and sing your song while the party is still on.
author: Rasheed Ogunlaru

text: I'll never forget. I'll never give up. I'll never be quiet. I promise.
author: Angie Thomas

text: When we share those stories we've been scared to share, voicelessness loses its wicked grasp.
author: Jo Ann Fore

text: Your voice is the most potent magic in existence.
author: Michael Bassey Johnson

text: My truth asked people to understand and to learn about depths of pain they had previously walked past…. I had kept my silence for a reason.
author: Chris Pepple

text: Writing is more about telling other peoples' stories than your own.
author: Carla H. Krueger

text: You are closer than you think and more qualified in your message than you could ever fathom.
author: Rebecca Campbell

text: After all, you could use your outside voice and scream your head off, but sometimes it didn't seem as if the screaming was being heard.
author: Meg Wolitzer

text: Three Things I Know To Be True: 1. Yes. You ARE a writer. 2. The world is waiting for YOUR voice. 3. Nobody can tell your story but YOU.
author: Jeanette LeBlanc

text: Finding your voice is a journey of discovering yourself.
author: Ute Wieczorek-King
source: Distinctive Voice: The fearless guide to a wholehearted blog worth noticing

text: Finding your voice is about having the confidence to know you matter so you can use your voice.
author: Cammi Granato

text: The hardest part of finding my voice was finding the courage to believe my voice could actually make an impact.
author: Rosalie Fishon

text: When was the last time my heart smiled?
author: Chaunté Lowe

text: Center yourself in your competency first. When you step into a conversation around your competency it's a risk but it's less risky than you think because you'll retreat to the knowledge you've gained from past experiences.
author: Maya Mendoza-Exstromon

text: The feelings were ones I'd already felt and had been writing about. When I got the chance to speak up it was a chance to express what I'd already been feeling and writing about.
author: Rosalie Fish

text: When I'm hungry, I eat. When I'm thirsty, I drink. When I feel like saying something, I say it.
author: Madonna

text: Give voice to what you know to be true, and do not be afraid of being disliked or exiled. I think that's the hard work of standing up for what you see.
author: Eve Ensler

text: We who have means and a voice must use them to help those who have neither.
author: Jennifer Donnelly

text: When the whole world is silent, even one voice becomes powerful.
author: Malala Yousafzai

text: When we speak we are afraid our words will not be heard or welcomed. But when we are silent, we are still afraid. So it is better to speak.
author: Audre Lorde

text: Speech has power. Words do not fade. What starts out as a sound, ends in a deed.
author: Abraham Joshua Herschel

text: The most courageous act is still to think for yourself. Aloud.
author: Coco Chanel

text: Speak up and speak clearly. I want to hear what you have to say because it matters. Let's listen to each other and respect one another's opinions.
author: Felicia Johnson

text: And even when they refuse to listen, I'll keep talking anyway, hoping on a slim chance that the things inside my head are worth something to someone.
author: Nadege Richards

text: Our lives begin to end the day we become silent about the things that matter.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

text: It only takes one voice, at the right pitch, to start an avalanche.
author: Dianna Hardy

text: In life, finding a voice is speaking and living the truth. Each of you is an original. Each of you has a distinctive voice. When you find it, your story will be told. You will be heard.
author: John Grisham

text: Throughout history, it has been the inaction of those who could have acted; the indifference of those who should have known better; the silence of the voice of justice when it mattered most; that has made it possible for evil to triumph.
author: Haile Selassie

text: Ships that pass in the night, and speak each other in passing, only a signal shown, and a distant voice in the darkness; So on the ocean of life, we pass and speak one another, only a look and a voice, then darkness again and a silence.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

text: Stand before the people you fear and speak your mind - even if your voice shakes.
author: Maggie Kuhn

text: Social media is the ultimate equalizer. It gives a voice and a platform to anyone willing to engage.
author: Amy Jo Martin

text: War is so unjust and ugly that all who wage it must try to stifle the voice of conscience within themselves.
author: Leo Tolstoy

text: The one thing that you have that nobody else has is you. Your voice, your mind, your story, your vision. So write and draw and build and play and dance and live as only you can.
author: Neil Gaiman

text: The voice of the intellect is a soft one, but it does not rest until it has gained a hearing.
author: Sigmund Freud

text: Justice is conscience, not a personal conscience but the conscience of the whole of humanity. Those who clearly recognize the voice of their own conscience usually recognize also the voice of justice.
author: Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn

text: I got a greater purpose. God put something in my heart to get across, and that's what I'm going to focus on, using my voice as an instrument and doing what needs to be done.
author: Kendrick Lamar

text: Sometimes we should express our gratitude for the small and simple things like the scent of the rain, the taste of your favorite food, or the sound of a loved one's voice.
author: Joseph B. Wirthlin

text: That inner voice has both gentleness and clarity. So to get to authenticity, you really keep going down to the bone, to the honesty, and the inevitability of something.
author: Meredith Monk

text: We often refuse to accept an idea merely because the tone of voice in which it has been expressed is unsympathetic to us.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: If I have a platform and a voice, I should use it for my people.
author: Bad Bunny

text: The human voice is the first and most natural musical instrument, also the most emotional.
author: Klaus Schulze

text: If you hear a voice within you say 'you cannot paint,' then by all means paint, and that voice will be silenced.
author: Vincent Van Gogh

text: Real guts are nothing more than developing your inner voice to the point where it is louder and stronger than the voice of your fear.
author: Georgette Mosbacher

text: Listen to the inner voice that allows you to be you!
author: Elvis Stojko

text: Have the courage to follow your heart and intuition. They somehow already know what you truly want to become. Everything else is secondary.
author: Steve Jobs

text: Do not believe in me or any other teacher, rather trust in your own inner voice. This is your guide, this is your teacher. Your teacher is within not without. Know yourself, not me!
author: Peace Pilgrim

text: Listening to the inner voice - trusting the inner voice - is one of the most important lessons of leadership.
author: Warren G. Bennis

text: Somewhere inside, we hear a voice. It leads us in the direction of the person we wish to become. But it is up to us whether or not to follow.
author: Pat Tillman

text: When we hear our inner voice and follow it, we can walk our own path.
author: Ilchi Lee

text: There is always one true inner voice. Trust it.
author: Gloria Steinem

text: Always listen to your inner voice.
author: Oprah Winfrey

text: What the inner voice says will not disappoint the hoping soul.
author: Friedrich Schiller

text: Don't let the voice of other people's opinion drown your inner voice.
author: Steve Jobs

text: To find your angels... Start trusting your inner voice and intuition.
author: Melanie

text: Listen to your inner voice. Trust your intuition. It's important to have the courage to trust yourself.
author: Dawn Ostroff

text: Listen to your inner-voice: Surround yourself with loving, nurturing people. Fall in love with your art and find yourself. Music is the great communicator.
author: Glenn Hughes

text: Being active every day makes it easier to hear that inner voice.
author: Haruki Murakami

text: Your inner voice, your instinct, knows everything.
author: Henry Winkler

text: Nature... is nothing but the inner voice of self-interest.
author: Charles Baudelaire

text: The ego constantly competes with the spirit for control over your inner voice.
author: Darren Johnson

text: We try to fulfill ourselves, even though our inner voice tells us to become all that we are - still, we run from it.
author: Frederick Lenz

text: Moment after moment, completely devote yourself to listening to your inner voice.
author: Shunryu Suzuki

text: Listen to the inner light; It will guide you. Listen to the inner Peace; It will feed you. Listen to the inner Love; It will transform you, It will divinise you, It will immortalise you.
author: Sri Chinmoy
